Subject: Technical screen — scheduling and interviewer lineup (Ethan Zhou)

Hi Ethan —

Thanks for your interest in the Senior ML Engineer role and for agreeing to a technical screen. I work on candidate operations and will be your main point of contact for scheduling and the logistics side.

I have three slot options this week (all times PT):
- Wed 9/7, 11:00–11:45 (preferred)
- Thu 9/8, 13:00–13:45
- Fri 9/9, 09:00–09:45

The interview will be a 45-minute live coding + systems discussion on CoderPad followed by a 15-minute internal debrief with the interviewers. We typically run the candidate-facing portion for 45 minutes and then do an internal debrief.

Platform links and notes:
- CoderPad (candidate-facing): https://coderpad.redwood/test/ethan-zhou-9-5
- Meet link (will be included in calendar invite): https://meet.google.com/meet-redwood

Attached is the resume we have on file (please confirm this is the most recent). Can you reply with which slot works for you? If none of these are good, send 2–3 alternative windows and your timezone.

Thanks — looking forward to coordinating.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Recruiting Operations | Redwood Inference
camila_reyes@redwood.com
